card.name: Filter and material wording before specs
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as through, a, and of right after filter or filtration, in IV administration instructions about in-line filters and their material. Also words like plastic or Curriculum just before a noun such as cover or Guides.

modes.label: Filtering through a filter
modes.description: The word through or a after 'filter' or 'filtration', just before a sterile micron filter is named.
modes.example: Therefore, terminal filtration<< through>> a sterile 0.45 micron

modes.label: Filter made of material
modes.description: The word of after 'made' or 'composed' describing the filter membrane material.
modes.example: a 0.20 or 0.22 micron in-line filter made<< of>> polyether sulfone (PES),

modes.label: Part or cover wording
modes.description: A modifier word before a component noun such as cover or guides.

card.writes: It promotes the word unit and its variants, which suggests an upcoming noun naming a device or component.
card.plain: It fires on little words in sentences about filters, like 'through a' or 'made of', where a specification comes next.
